descriptions.zh: 将一个应用从启用状态变为禁用状态时，应用全部功能不可用（如SSO、账户同步等），请确认您已知该操作可能导致的风险。
descriptions.en: When you change an application from the enabled state to the disabled state, all features of the application become unavailable (such as SSO and account synchronization). Confirm that you are aware of the risks that this operation may cause.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam disable-application --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --application-id app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam DisableApplication --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --ApplicationId app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx
